title: Mitchell TTX · SEAD mission
subtitle: 24-hour concept: ISR, stimulate, strike, harass and assess
description: The Mitchell Institute 2024 SEAD tabletop-exercise concept (Figure 9, pp. 20-21): overlapping ISR, deception, electronic attack and strike activity against notional coastal and surface-action-group air defenses over a 24-hour planning window.
assumptions: Figure 9 provides a 24-hour conceptual mission sequence, not georeferenced flight tracks or verified engagement results.
The playback lasts 75 display seconds for navigation; source phases overlap and recur, so screen phase boundaries do not represent actual clock timestamps or strict operational succession.

Report text p. 20 identifies three orbits of CCA-10/EA-37B and one RC-135 orbit; Figure 9 additionally names CCA-11 with continuous ISR. Both are recorded here without asserting a resolved exact orbit composition.
TTX CCA-12 was a team-modified concept based on CCA-8; no confirmed physical silhouette or flight path is published. All map placement is editorial.

Additional CCA-4, CCA-7 and CCA-12 symbols visualize platform participation explicitly documented in Figure 9 and pp. 20–21, not aircraft quantities, tactical formations, actual flight paths or engagement results.
Expendable CCA icons use conceptual outbound paths only, not recovery legs; any final stationary display is a visualization artifact, not evidence of survival or loitering.

Independent aircraft are visually separated by editorial east/north offsets (kilometers) to keep silhouettes legible. These offsets do NOT represent recorded formation spacing, basing locations, or TTX tactical geometry.

phases.title: Phase 1 · Continuous ISR
phases.narrative: The TTX depicts continuing ISR across the 24-hour concept using CCA-10, EA-37B and RC-135, with CCA-11 also listed in Figure 9.

phases.title: Phase 2 · Stimulate, Decoy, Jam
phases.narrative: Notional CCA-9, CCA-11 and CCA-12 pressure and electronically disrupt defensive systems in the exercise concept.

phases.title: Phase 3 · Strike SAGs
phases.narrative: Figure 9 Phase 3: CCA-4 and CCA-7 alongside crewed penetrating and stand-off aircraft carry the reported strike concept, employing AARGM, LRASM and SiAW against notional surface action groups; depicted positions are illustrative.

phases.title: Phase 4 · Harass and Electronic Attack
phases.narrative: The concept repeats expendable-CCA harassment and electronic attack between strike activities.

phases.title: Phase 4a · Harass and BDA
phases.narrative: The exercise depicts ongoing harassment and bomb-damage-assessment functions; no actual assessments are published.
